projectAgent.nudge: This project has an agent that keeps its memory: facts, lessons and decisions. Ask it with `devpit_project_agent_consult` before exploring broadly, and before choosing a pattern its memory may already settle: where something is, how something is done here, whether it was decided. It answers for this project only, {questions} questions per session. What is worth remembering goes to `devpit_project_agent_propose`, which waits for the person's approval: never edit `.devpit/project-agent/` yourself.
